name: surjective_pairing'
statement: theorem surjective_pairing' : ∀ n m : Nat, (n,m) = (fst (n,m), snd (n,m))
proof:
:= by
  intro n m
  rfl

name: surjective_pairing
statement: theorem surjective_pairing : ∀ p : NatProd, p = (fst p, snd p)
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  cases p with
  | pair n m => rfl

name: nil_app
statement: theorem nil_app : ∀ l : NatList, [] ++ l = l
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  rfl

name: tl_length_pred
statement: theorem tl_length_pred : ∀ l : NatList, Nat.pred (length l) = length (tl l)
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  cases l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons h t => simp [length, tl]

name: app_assoc
statement: theorem app_assoc : ∀ l1 l2 l3 : NatList, (l1 ++ l2) ++ l3 = l1 ++ (l2 ++ l3)
proof:
:= by
  intros l1 l2 l3
  induction l1 with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons h t ih => simp [app] <;> rewrite [ih] <;> rfl

name: repeat_plus
statement: theorem repeat_plus : ∀ c1 c2 n : Nat, repeatN n c1 ++ repeatN n c2 = repeatN n (c1 + c2)
proof:
:= by
  intros c1 c2 n
  induction c1 with
  | zero => simp <;> rfl
  | succ c1' ih =>
    simp [repeatN, app]
    rewrite [ih, <- repeatN]
    simp [Nat.succ_add]

name: app_length_succ
statement: theorem app_length_succ : ∀ l n, length (l ++ [n]) = Nat.succ (length l)
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro n <;> rfl
  | cons h t ih => intro n <;> simp [app, length] <;> rewrite [ih] <;> rfl

name: rev_length
statement: theorem rev_length : ∀ l : NatList, length (rev l) = length l
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons h t ih =>
    simp [rev, length]
    rewrite [app_length_succ, ih]
    simp [Nat.one_add]

name: app_length
statement: theorem app_length : ∀ l1 l2 : NatList, length (l1 ++ l2) = length l1 + length l2
proof:
:= by
  intros l1 l2
  induction l1 with
  | nil => simp [app, length]
  | cons h t ih =>
    simp [app, length]
    rewrite [ih]
    simp [Nat.succ_add]

name: leb_n_succ
statement: theorem leb_n_succ : ∀ n, (n <=? Nat.succ n) = true
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp [leb] <;> rewrite [ih] <;> rfl

name: zero_add
statement: theorem zero_add : ∀ n : Nat, 0 + n = n
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  simp

name: zero_add''
statement: theorem zero_add'': ∀ n : Nat, 0 + n = n
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  simp

name: add_one
statement: theorem add_one : ∀ n : Nat, n + 1 = Nat.succ n
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  simp

name: zero_mul
statement: theorem zero_mul : ∀ n : Nat, 0 * n = 0
proof:
:= by
  intros n
  simp

name: plus_id_example
statement: theorem plus_id_example : ∀ n m : Nat, n = m → n + n = m + m
proof:
:= by
  
  intro n m
  
  intro h
  
  rewrite [h]
  rfl

name: mul_zero_add_mul_zero_eq_zero
statement: theorem mul_zero_add_mul_zero_eq_zero : ∀ p q : Nat, (p * 0) + (q * 0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro p q
  rewrite [Nat.mul_zero]
  rewrite [Nat.mul_zero]
  rfl

name: add_one_neq_zero
statement: theorem add_one_neq_zero : ∀ n : Nat, (n + 1 =? 0) = false
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  cases n
  rfl
  rfl

name: not_involutive
statement: theorem not_involutive : ∀ b : Bool, not (not b) = b
proof:
:= by
  intro b
  cases b
  . rfl
  . rfl

name: and_commutative
statement: theorem and_commutative : ∀ b c : Bool, and b c = and c b
proof:
:= by
  intro b c
  cases b
  . cases c
    . rfl
    . rfl
  . cases c
    . rfl
    . rfl

name: and_commutative'
statement: theorem and_commutative' : ∀ b c : Bool, and b c = and c b
proof:
:= by
  intro b c
  cases b with
  | true => cases c with
    | true => rfl
    | false => rfl
  | false => cases c with
    | true => rfl
    | false => rfl

name: and_commutative'''
statement: theorem and_commutative''' : ∀ b c : Bool, and b c = and c b
proof:
:= by
  intro b c
  cases b <;> cases c <;> rfl

name: and3_exchange
statement: theorem and3_exchange : ∀ b c d : Bool, and (and b c) d = and (and b d) c
proof:
:= by
  intro b c d
  cases b
  . cases c
    . cases d
      . rfl
      . rfl
    . cases d
      . rfl
      . rfl
  . cases c
    . cases d
      . rfl
      . rfl
    . cases d
      . rfl
      . rfl

name: and3_exchange'
statement: theorem and3_exchange' : ∀ b c d : Bool, and (and b c) d = and (and b d) c
proof:
:= by
  intro b c d
  cases b <;> cases c <;> cases d <;> rfl

name: next_nat_partial_function
statement: theorem next_nat_partial_function : PartialFunction NextNat
proof:
:= by
  intro x y1 y2 h1 h2
  cases h1
  cases h2
  rfl

name: le_not_a_partial_function
statement: theorem le_not_a_partial_function : ¬(PartialFunction Nat.le)
proof:
:= by
  intro Hc
  have Nonsense : 0 = 1 := by
    apply Hc 0 0 1
    · exact Nat.le.refl
    · exact Nat.le.step Nat.le.refl
  contradiction

name: le_reflexive
statement: theorem le_reflexive : Reflexive Nat.le
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  apply Nat.le_refl

name: le_trans
statement: theorem le_trans : Transitive Nat.le
proof:
:= by
  intro n m o Hnm Hmo
  induction Hmo with
  | refl =>
    exact Hnm
  | step _ IHHmo =>
    apply Nat.le_succ_of_le
    exact IHHmo

name: lt_trans
statement: theorem lt_trans : Transitive Nat.lt
proof:
:= by
  intro n m o Hnm Hmo
  have Hnm := Nat.le_succ_of_le Hnm
  apply le_trans (b := m.succ)
  · exact Hnm
  · exact Hmo

name: le_Sn_le
statement: theorem le_Sn_le : ∀ n m, Nat.succ n ≤ m → n ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  intro n m h
  refine Nat.le_trans ?_ h
  exact Nat.le.step Nat.le.refl

name: le_order
statement: theorem le_order : Order Nat.le
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact Nat.le_refl
  · constructor
    · exact fun _ _ => Nat.le_antisymm
    · exact fun _ _ _ => Nat.le_trans

name: next_nat_closure_is_le
statement: theorem next_nat_closure_is_le : ∀ n m, n ≤ m ↔ ClosReflTrans NextNat n m
proof:
:= by
  intro n m
  apply Iff.intro
  · intro H
    induction H with
    | refl => apply ClosReflTrans.rt_refl
    | step _ ih =>
      apply ClosReflTrans.rt_trans ih
      apply ClosReflTrans.rt_step
      constructor
  · intro H
    induction H with
    | rt_step H =>
      cases H
      apply Nat.le.step
      apply Nat.le.refl
    | rt_refl =>
      apply Nat.le.refl
    | rt_trans _ _ ih1 ih2 =>
      exact Nat.le_trans ih1 ih2

name: rsc_R
statement: theorem rsc_R : ∀ (X : Type) (R : Relation X) (x y : X), R x y → ClosReflTrans1n R x y
proof:
:= by
  intro X R x y H
  apply ClosReflTrans1n.rt1n_trans H
  apply ClosReflTrans1n.rt1n_refl

name: add_zero_r
statement: theorem add_zero_r : ∀ n : Nat, n + 0 = n
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n' ih => simp <;> rewrite [ih] <;> rfl

name: sub_self
statement: theorem sub_self : ∀ n : Nat, n - n = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n' ih => simp <;> rewrite [ih] <;> rfl

name: mul_zero_plus'
statement: theorem mul_zero_plus' : ∀ n m : Nat, (n + 0 + 0) * m = n * m
proof:
:= by
  intro n m
  have h : n + 0 + 0 = n := by
    rewrite [add_comm] <;> simp <;> rewrite [add_comm] <;> rfl
  rewrite [h]
  rfl

name: plus_rearrange_secondtry
statement:
theorem plus_rearrange_secondtry :
  ∀ n m p q : Nat,
  (n + m) + (p + q) = (m + n) + (p + q)
proof:
:= by
  intro n m p q
  rewrite [add_comm n m] 
  rfl

name: plus_rearrange
statement:
theorem plus_rearrange :
  ∀ n m p q : Nat,
  (n + m) + (p + q) = (m + n) + (p + q)
proof:
:= by
  intro n m p q
  have h : n + m = m + n := by 
    rewrite [add_comm] <;> rfl
  rewrite [h]
  rfl
